# Xsink

> Universal Redis Streams → PostgreSQL pipeline with a configurable mapping: what to read and where to write is defined in mapping.json, with no code changes.

Go 1.25 service, no CGO. It reads Redis streams through SOCKS5 proxies over mTLS (one or more Redis sources), converts entry fields according to mapping.json, and writes them to PostgreSQL with one multi-row INSERT per batch. At-least-once delivery: XACK+XDEL happen only after the row is stored in the target table or in dead_letters. Transient failures keep the batch in the Redis PEL for retry; only unrecoverable data (SQLSTATE classes 22/23, conversion errors) goes to dead_letters. Circuit breakers per Redis source and for Postgres, exponential backoff with jitter, XAUTOCLAIM reclaim of stuck messages, proxy failover, graceful shutdown. Runs as a systemd service (Type=notify, WatchdogSec, hardening) and exposes /healthz, /readyz, and Prometheus /metrics.

## Configuration
- [config.yaml.example](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/config.yaml.example): infrastructure template: log, proxy, redis[] sources with mTLS, postgres DSN and auto_migrate, pipeline, mapping.path, http.addr, reclaim, breaker
- [mapping.json.example](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/mapping.json.example): streams[] template: source, name, consumer_group, batch_size, block_ms, table, id_column, primary_key, on_conflict, fields[] (redis, column, type, not_null, encoding)
- Supported field types: text, uuid, integer, bigint, real, double, boolean, jsonb, timestamptz, bytea
- The Postgres password can be supplied through the XSINK_POSTGRES_DSN environment variable, which overrides postgres.dsn

## Source
- [cmd/xsink/main.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/cmd/xsink/main.go): entry point, CLI flags --config, --print-ddl, --version
- [internal/config/config.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/config/config.go): config.yaml loading
- [internal/mapping/mapping.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/mapping/mapping.go): mapping.json parsing and validation
- [internal/pipeline/pipeline.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/pipeline/pipeline.go): XREADGROUP workers, batching, INSERT, XACK/XDEL, dead-letter routing
- [internal/pipeline/convert.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/pipeline/convert.go): Redis field to SQL value conversion
- [internal/storage/storage.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/storage/storage.go): PostgreSQL access, DDL generation, auto_migrate
- [internal/redisclient/redisclient.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/redisclient/redisclient.go): Redis sources with mTLS over SOCKS5
- [internal/proxylist/proxylist.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/proxylist/proxylist.go): proxy list, selection strategy, health marking
- [internal/reclaim/reclaim.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/reclaim/reclaim.go): XAUTOCLAIM reclaim of stuck messages
- [internal/breaker/breaker.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/breaker/breaker.go): circuit breaker
- [internal/httpapi/httpapi.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/httpapi/httpapi.go): /healthz, /readyz, /metrics
- [internal/metrics/metrics.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/metrics/metrics.go): Prometheus metrics (xsink_* series)
- [internal/logging/logging.go](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/internal/logging/logging.go): journal or stdout log sink

## Build and deployment
- [Makefile](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/Makefile): build, build-linux, print-ddl, test, tidy, clean
- [deploy/systemd/xsink.service](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/deploy/systemd/xsink.service): systemd unit with Type=notify, WatchdogSec, restart limits, hardening
- [.gitignore](https://github.com/Insider515/Xsink/blob/master/.gitignore): config.yaml, mapping.json, keys, proxies.txt, env files and binaries are never committed
